---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Trinity Harden"
execute:
  echo: false
---
```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
#| message: false
library(readxl)
```
```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```
```{r}
births_by_date <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(avg_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")
births_by_date
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  births_by_date,
  aes(
    x = date_of_month,
    y = factor(month, levels = rev(1:12), labels = rev(month.abb)),
    fill = avg_births
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(x = "Day of month", y = "Month", fill = "Mean births")
```
```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    christmas_births = births[month == 12 & date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[month == 12 & date_of_month == 25],
    baseline_births = mean(
      births[month == 12 & date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]
    ),
    pct_of_baseline = christmas_births / baseline_births * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
christmas_births
```
```{r}
ggplot(christmas_births, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday"
  )
```
```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ year + month + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)
summary(births_model)$r.squared
```
```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = residuals(births_model) / mean(births) * 100)

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(calendar_date = make_date(2001, month, date_of_month))
calendar_resid
```
```{r}
holiday_labels <- tribble(
  ~calendar_date, ~label_date, ~label_y, ~holiday, ~label_hjust,
  as.Date("2001-12-25"), as.Date("2001-12-22"), -47, "Christmas Day", 1,
  as.Date("2001-12-24"), as.Date("2001-12-20"), -34, "Christmas Eve", 1,
  as.Date("2001-01-01"), as.Date("2001-01-10"), -33, "New Year's Day", 0,
  as.Date("2001-07-04"), as.Date("2001-07-11"), -28, "Independence Day", 0
) |>
  left_join(calendar_resid, by = "calendar_date")

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_segment(
    data = holiday_labels,
    aes(
      x = calendar_date,
      xend = label_date,
      y = mean_pct_resid,
      yend = label_y
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray40"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = holiday_labels,
    aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = holiday, hjust = label_hjust),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = "Calendar date", y = "Mean residual (% of average births)")
```
